AniMusic could not tell what that link is
Choose the language used by AniMusic.
Shapes the sound inside AniMusic, before it reaches the system.
Runs after AniMusic\'s, on the whole audio session. Using both applies both.
First set AniMusic\'s battery usage to Unrestricted. Higher refresh rates use more battery, CPU and GPU, and may warm your device.
Enable only if AniMusic\'s battery use is set to Unrestricted. Android can still limit the refresh rate when the device is hot or low on power.
Point AniMusic at an addon server you host or were given a link to
Signing in opens Discord\'s login page. Nothing is typed into AniMusic.
Paste the addon’s URL — either its root or its manifest.json. AniMusic reads what it can search and stream, then asks it for tracks over plain HTTP.
If a source does not have a track or cannot be reached, AniMusic tries the next one. Sources above YouTube can replace its recording when they return a better version.
Listen a little more and AniMusic will turn your history into a Replay.
Point AniMusic at a WebDAV music folder — your Nextcloud Music directory or any server speaking WebDAV.
Point AniMusic at a shared music folder — a NAS or Windows share speaking SMB.
